remarks: The Rio model by Daytona Homes delivers a brilliantly utilized 2-storey floor plan featuring 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, built for modern family functionality. The bright, open-concept main floor connects a spacious great room and dining area with a streamlined kitchen, offering ample storage and an efficient workspace that keeps cooking organized. A private half bath completes the level, while a functional rear entry provides seamless access to the backyard.  Upstairs revolves around a versatile central bonus room perfect for play or relaxation. The second level also hosts a convenient laundry closet, two comfortable secondary bedrooms, a full main bath, and a private primary retreat featuring a large walk-in closet and a beautifully appointed ensuite. Maximize your property's potential by adding the optional basement development to completely customize the home to your lifestyle. Pictures are of renderings.  Actual colors and upgrades may vary.
